answer.diagnosis: The shortcut is a corner-marker detector in the top-left 3x3 patch (image rows 1-3, columns 1-3), which is far from the central blob. Almost every structured layer-1 unit has unusually large weights (magnitude about 40-99) on exactly this patch, much larger than its weights on the surrounding background. Units 0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 10, 18, 20 and 29 have strongly positive patch weights. Units 5, 6, 9, 14, 15, 21, 24, 27 and 30 have strongly negative ones. These same units also carry the blob-size templates: a centre ring or disc, with an opposite-signed surround. Their patch sign lines up with how layer 2 and the output use them, so a bright patch in that corner pushes the logit just as blob size does. That is a spurious feature correlated with the label, not blob size. The fix sets the patch weights to zero in all layer-1 units, which removes the model's sensitivity to that corner and leaves the centre-blob templates unchanged.

edits.reason: remove top-left corner patch shortcut detector
